name: ponytail
description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.
one_liner: A set of instructions that trains an AI coding assistant to write the smallest possible fix instead of bloated code, like a terse senior developer glancing over its shoulder.
buyer: A freelance developer or small dev shop billing clients for AI-assisted work who wants leaner, cheaper-to-review pull requests.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer installs it on every client project so AI-generated pull requests are smaller and faster for non-technical clients to approve.
A coding bootcamp uses it as a teaching contrast, showing students bloated vs. minimal AI output side by side.
An agency that pays per AI token used adopts it to cut its own AI coding bill, improving margins on fixed-price projects.

money_ideas.idea: Bundle it with other agent 'personality' presets (paranoid security reviewer, strict test writer) into a paid style pack sold to teams standardizing AI workflows.

steal_this: This weekend, package it with 2-3 other personality presets into one installable bundle and sell it to indie devs who want to swap their agent's style per task.
